title: Refract incident hypotheses (investigator records)
description: ai/runs/<run_id>/reviews/hypotheses.json — the competing root-cause hypotheses of one incident investigation (/investigate-incident, observability pack). Each read-only investigator instance is briefed with ONE hypothesis id and ends its final message with this JSON carrying that hypothesis; the SubagentStop hook persist-review.sh validates it, stamps signer / authors / scope, and MERGES it into the run's hypotheses.json by id (same incident). Nothing writes this file through a tool (test-lock.sh). The investigation is closed only when the file holds >= 3 hypotheses, each with its evidence for and against.

incident.description: The incident id, or the firing alert and its start time; records of another incident never merge.

signer.description: Stamped by the SubagentStop hook from its own input — the model never writes it.

authors.description: Stamped: every agent type that edited a scoped path, from the edit ledger test-lock.sh keeps (.claude/evidence/edits.jsonl); `main` for the main session or an edit the ledger did not see.

scope.description: Stamped: the change the record judged — every path touched since the merge-base (run records, evidence and locks excluded) plus the run's acceptance.json, each with its blob hash. gate-check.py recomputes it; any difference makes the record STALE, and a stale record is a FAIL.

source.description: Where it was read: <file>:<line>, a log line (<file>:<line> in the bundle), a query with its time range, a deploy-ledger row, a commit sha.

observation.description: What that source shows, stated so a reader can check it there.

hypothesis.description: One candidate root cause, as a mechanism: what changed or failed, and how it produces the symptom.

claim.description: When <condition>, <code or config at file:line> produces <the symptom> instead of <expected>.

root_cause.description: The line where the cause lives (code, config, migration, manifest). Required when verdict is supported — persist-review.sh rejects a supported hypothesis without it.

verdict.description: supported needs >=1 supporting item and a root_cause; refuted needs >=1 contradicting item (checked by persist-review.sh).

next_probe.description: For inconclusive: the read-only probe that would decide it.
